header.character_watermark: Symmy matching shapes in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Look at 5 pairs. Mark CONGRUENT or NOT.

image_placeholders.description: 5 pair rows for Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Each row: 2 shapes side by side + checkboxes 'CONGRUENT' / 'NOT'. Pairs: same triangles, different sized squares, same hexagons (one rotated), triangle + square, same circles.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P1_PAIRS at Part 1: keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Same triangles: CONGRUENT. Different squares: NOT. Same hexagons: CONGRUENT (rotation OK). Triangle vs square: NOT. Same circles: CONGRUENT.

parts.student_instructions: For each shape, find the CONGRUENT partner from a row of 5.
parts.visual_layout: A find-the-partner layout with 4 reference shapes on the left and 5 candidate partners on the right (4 congruent + 1 wrong size).

image_placeholders.description: A find-the-match layout for Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Left: 4 reference shapes. Right: 5 candidate partners (4 congruent + 1 different-size). Wide gap for line-drawing matches.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P2_FIND at Part 2: instructions ask the child to find a congruent partner among shapes. Keywords name the visual elements.

parts.answer_key: Each reference shape matches one of 4 same-size partners; the 5th candidate is the wrong size.

parts.student_instructions: Draw a shape CONGRUENT to the given one.
parts.visual_layout: A reference shape + blank space for drawing.

image_placeholders.description: A reference shape (medium triangle) on the left + a blank space on the right for the child to draw a congruent partner. Optional grid background to help.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P3_DRAW at Part 3: keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Drawing of triangle same dimensions as reference (rotation allowed).

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, draw 2 different non-congruent triangles.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation. Use Part 1 as formative — children testing rotation properly.
